product_risk_or_requirement: The AI inventory entry and legal classification for a patient-facing triage assistant must be documented and approved
current_state: Only a preliminary classification made by the product team exists
product_requirement: Block any patient-facing release until legal review maps the triage workflow to the AI Law, its implementing decree and the current high-risk list
acceptance_criteria: Given the final triage scope and the Vietnam market When pilot readiness is reviewed Then a signed classification memo and an inventory record are present
evidence_needed: Signed classification memo and system inventory record

product_risk_or_requirement: Symptom transcripts are health data, so consent, purpose limitation, retention and vendor transfer have to be settled before launch
current_state: Consent text is drafted, but the retention period and the cloud vendor transfer terms are not settled
product_requirement: Require an explicit consent record and a defined retention period before any symptom transcript is stored or sent to a vendor
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient starts symptom intake When the transcript is stored or transferred to a processor Then a consent record, a stated purpose and a retention date are attached to it
evidence_needed: Consent record sample, retention policy and signed vendor data processing agreement

product_risk_or_requirement: Emergency triage and dispatch AI falls within an Annex III high-risk area, and a symptom assistant may additionally fall under medical device rules
current_state: Human oversight is designed but not independently verified, and the medical device question is undecided
product_requirement: Complete the role analysis, risk management, evaluation and oversight rehearsal, and resolve the medical device question before offering the assistant in the EU
acceptance_criteria: Given an EU launch candidate When release approval is requested Then an applicability memo, an evaluation report and a signed human oversight procedure exist
deadline_or_trigger: Before offering the assistant in the European Union
evidence_needed: Applicability memo, evaluation report, oversight procedure and release approval record

product_risk_or_requirement: Under-triage has to be measured against real outcomes, otherwise the main safety claim of the product is untested
current_state: No under-triage measurement exists; the pilot currently reports volume and latency only
product_requirement: Every case later treated as an emergency must be traceable back to the urgency level the assistant suggested, in a weekly safety report
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient is later treated as an emergency When the weekly safety report is produced Then the suggested urgency level, the nurse decision and the time gap appear for that patient
deadline_or_trigger: Before pilot traffic exceeds 100 patients per day
evidence_needed: Weekly under-triage report with the traced case list and the nurse decision trail

product_risk_or_requirement: Queue priority ordering can reproduce the cost and utilization proxy bias seen in population health algorithms
current_state: The priority feature is built but switched off, and it has never been tested by patient subgroup
product_requirement: Publish under-triage rates by monitored patient group and get safety committee sign-off before queue priority ordering is enabled for patients
acceptance_criteria: Given queue priority ordering is proposed for activation When the clinical safety committee reviews it Then subgroup under-triage rates, the feature list and the agreed gap threshold are documented
deadline_or_trigger: Only when queue priority ordering is enabled, not for this release
evidence_needed: Subgroup under-triage report, feature inventory and safety committee decision record

product_risk_or_requirement: A model, prompt or vendor change can silently change triage behavior after the release gate has already been passed
current_state: No change gate is defined; prompt edits currently ship with the normal application release
product_requirement: Any model, prompt or vendor change must re-run the triage safety test set and carry clinical sign-off before it reaches patients
acceptance_criteria: Given a model, prompt or vendor change When a release is requested Then a safety test result and a clinical sign-off record are attached to that release
deadline_or_trigger: Before the assistant leaves pilot stage
evidence_needed: Triage safety test result and clinical sign-off record per change
